Asked how he builds rockets, he gave a two-word answer: I read.

Kevin Trudeau tells the story of a man who was asked how he knows how to build rockets. His answer was just two words. Kevin says leaders are always readers, because the most successful people are curious and simply want to know.

He adds that wanting to know is different from needing to know.

When did you last learn something just because you were curious?

#ad #success #mindset

Why do the wealthy invest early in personal development?

Kevin Trudeau quotes Warren Buffett on what rich people do differently. Early in their careers they spend time and money learning how the mind works, plus the skills that lead to success in business, in life and in relationships.

Kevin adds that all of that learning mostly means reading.

What are you learning about your own mind right now?

#ad #money #mindset #success

Successful people do what the other guys won't do.

Kevin Trudeau says successful people are always willing to do what others are not. He points to Elon Musk making time to read an hour a day, then suggests most of us could manage fifteen minutes, three days a week.

He lists what people say they want: more success, better relationships, more happiness. His challenge is whether you are willing to do what it takes.

What is one thing you keep saying you want but have not started?

#ad #success #goals

The first thing to study is how your mind works.

Kevin Trudeau describes his own long, busy days: up at six in the morning, in his room late at night, and still time to read and study.

He says the most important thing to learn is how the mind works, and he points to Warren Buffett's advice on personal development. In his words, work on becoming a better you.

What excuse are you ready to drop today?

#ad #money #mindset #success

Reading a classic once is not the same as knowing it.

Kevin Trudeau has a simple answer for people who say they read the classics years ago. Would you skip lunch today because you ate lunch years ago?

He says you feed your body every day, so you need to feed your mind every day. And to know and not to do is not to know.

What is one lesson you know but have never applied?

#ad #success #mindset #habits

You do not have to start with an hour a day.

Kevin Trudeau says that if you cannot jump straight to what Elon Musk does, begin small. Pick one day a week, put it on your calendar and make an appointment with yourself. Spend ten minutes alone, with the door shut, reading about how the mind works.

Then build up to two days, then three, then longer sessions, step by step.

When could you fit ten quiet minutes into your week?

#ad #habits #mindset #goals
